evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stable at 39-40% across last three weeks

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility increases or stabilizes while RETAIL_REC fails to improve, indicating no substitution effect.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES recovered 11.3 points from t-2w to t-0w
